query: UPDATE eval_executions SET status='running',lease_owner=$2,lease_expires_at=NOW()+INTERVAL '60 seconds',deadline_at=NOW()+((1800000-active_runtime_ms)::TEXT || ' milliseconds')::INTERVAL,last_heartbeat_at=NOW(),fencing_token=fencing_token+1 WHERE id=$1 RETURNING to_jsonb(eval_executions) AS "record!: Json<ExecutionRecord>"
